verdict.rationale: Orb is a billing platform, and such a product could plausibly let users schedule recurring jobs or workflows, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only adjacent behaviors: vendor-managed daily data exports, fixed dunning retry intervals, recurring billing cycles, and one-off scheduled effective dates for subscription edits. None of these is a user-definable recurring job or workflow scheduler, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
